QuestInfo.name: The Sage's Confrontation
QuestInfo.0: The Monster Rat, who had been posing as the Handsome Monk all this time, was quietly putting into action his plan to dominate the entire town.
QuestInfo.1: The time for concealing yourself as a Trainee is past. Now it's time for Hoyoung, brilliant investigator and up-and-coming sage, to step in.
QuestInfo.2: The Monster Rat has grown too strong by siphoning the life force from the town's residents. Retreat seems like the best strategy for now.
